sections.html:
• Origin: South America
  • Height: 5 - 30+ cm
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2 demand: medium
Place individual plants 2-4 cm apart. Short runners form a compact group.

Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Sagittaria subulata from South America is an ideal, undemanding foreground plant whose short runners form a compact group. This plant may cause problems because in certain conditions it suddenly grows to a height of 50 cm when it grows older. But if it is then moved into the background it may become low again. In the aquarium it sometimes sends a long flower stem to the surface, and small white flowers unfold just above the water surface.
